name: com.odilelabs/gate
title: Odile Gate
description: Create a free Gate project. Give each app its own API key and choose which calls it can make.

tools.name: gate_create_project
tools.description: Create a Free project in front of an existing HTTPS API. No signup or payment required. For a credential-free demo use https://sandbox.gate.odilelabs.com with GET /customers/:cid/tickets/:id (customer A holds tickets 1-3, B holds 4-5: try GET /customers/A/tickets/1). Returns project_id, admin_key (shown once) and the gateway base URL apps call instead of the API. A real API and its credentials need owner authorization.

name.description: A name for the project, e.g. "Shop API"

upstream.description: The API base URL, https only, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1

header_name.description: Optional: the secret header your API expects, e.g. Authorization or apikey

header_value.description: Optional: its value. Stored encrypted; apps never see it.

tools.name: gate_update_project
tools.description: Update the project rejection-alert threshold or idle-app window using its existing settings API. Omitted settings and the webhook destination stay unchanged. threshold counts rejections per app in ten minutes (5–1000); idle_days flags apps after 1–90 idle days, never revokes them. Requires the owner key or an admin member key. Returns current alert settings; does not rename or delete the project.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project owner key (ga_...) or an admin member key (gm_...). Never print it.

threshold.description: Rejections per app within ten minutes that trigger an alert.

idle_days.description: Idle days before flagging an app; never revokes it.

tools.name: gate_create_app
tools.description: Give one app its own key and the calls it may make. Routes are rules like "GET /orders/:id", "POST /orders", "GET /users/{user}/orders" (per-user), or example calls like "GET /orders/42", which become rules allowing any id. Returns key (shown once), app.id and normalized rules. Send key as Authorization: Bearer <key> to the project gateway; never send the admin key to the workload.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

name.description: The app name, e.g. "storefront" or "nightly sync"

template.description: Ready-made API policy: reads allowed, risky writes held, destructive calls refused. Explicit routes replace the entire template policy. Free and Pro; configure the project upstream first. See /templates.

routes.description: Only the calls this app makes, one "METHOD /path" per item

per_minute.description: Calls per minute for this app (default 60)

expires_at.description: Pro: optional future ISO time with timezone, at most 30 days from creation. Rotation preserves this expiry.

max_calls.description: Pro: optional lifetime call allowance for this app. Rotation preserves its count.

models.description: For a model API: the only models this app may ask for, exact names or a prefix ending in * (e.g. ["gpt-4.1-mini", "claude-haiku-*"]). Omit for no model limit.

runs.description: Whether calls need a Gate Actions run (x-odile-run). Default writes: the app's writes need a run. Use off for a model or MCP gateway, where every call is a POST, or for direct writes; template apps default to off (their writes are held for approval).

tools.name: gate_list_apps
tools.description: Read the project's apps, allowed calls, limits, state, idle flags and anomaly-guard settings. Use it to select an app id. Use gate_manage_app_key to rotate its key or revoke a retired app.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

tools.name: gate_manage_app_key
tools.description: Rotate one app key (new key shown once, old key stops immediately) or revoke the app permanently. Both operations keep other apps unchanged; revoke requires gate_create_app to restore access. Use gate_list_apps to find the app; use gate_configure_app to change its settings without replacing its key.

operation.description: Perform exactly one operation: rotate, revoke.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

tools.name: gate_configure_app
tools.description: Set models, mandatory runs, response fields, or add one confirmed literal route to an existing app. Choose exactly one operation; models:null removes the model limit, response allow:null disables filtering, and runs:off removes the run requirement. Use gate_check_setup to inspect settings; apply learned routes and rate limits on the oversight endpoint, /mcp/oversight.

operation.description: Perform exactly one operation: models, runs, response, add_route.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

app.description: The active app id from gate_list_apps.

models.description: Exact names or prefixes ending in *; null for no limit

mode.description: Run requirement: off, writes, or all.

allow.description: Allowed JSON Pointer paths (1–32), or null to disable response filtering.

rule.description: One exact rule, e.g. GET /health; no *, :param, {user} or query.

confirm.description: Explicit owner-authorized confirmation to add this exact route.

tools.name: gate_check_setup
tools.description: Read actual project protection settings and configuration gaps without changing them. Configuration analysis only: no upstream requests, runtime enforcement test or security certificate. Config-file validation and application are separate capabilities when enabled.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

app.description: Optional: check one active app id (app_...) instead of all active apps

tools.name: gate_create_approver
tools.description: Approvers are people who decide held actions. Create a dedicated approver key (shown once) before granting approval actions; give it to that person, never to an agent. Only an active approver key can approve, reject or reopen actions in the dashboard.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

tools.name: gate_list_approvers
tools.description: Approvers are people who decide held actions. List active and revoked dedicated approvers with ids, names and creation times; never returns keys or hashes. Team members with the approver role are a separate list. Requires the project owner key or an active member key. Use gate_create_approver to issue a key, gate_revoke_approver to revoke one, or gate_manage_members to inspect team roles.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project owner key (ga_...) or an active member key (gm_...). Never print it.

tools.name: gate_revoke_approver
tools.description: Invalidate one dedicated approver key immediately; use gate_list_approvers to find its id. Requires the project owner key or an admin member key. A missing or already revoked id returns an error. To restore access issue a new key with gate_create_approver; to revoke a team member use gate_manage_members.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project owner key (ga_...) or an admin member key (gm_...). Never print it.

approver.description: The dedicated approver id from gate_list_approvers; not a member id or key.

tools.name: gate_list_actions
tools.description: Which actions are waiting for a human decision? Read held actions (pending by default, or another requested state) and their exact calls; this tool cannot decide or resubmit them. This also expires overdue held actions in the project and clears their stored request paths and bodies. Approving or rejecting a held action is done by a person with an approver key in the dashboard, by design. No MCP tool can approve actions.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

tools.name: gate_manage_members
tools.description: Members are people with project administration access according to their role. Use the project owner key to invite, list or revoke them; viewer and approver roles have narrower access than admins. Invites expire after 72 hours and their links and accepted keys are shown once; listing returns no secrets. Revocation invalidates a key or pending invite and is safe to repeat. Gate sends no email. For dedicated approval keys use gate_create_approver, gate_list_approvers and gate_revoke_approver.

operation.description: Perform exactly one operation: invite, list, revoke.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

role.description: Invited member role: viewer, approver, or admin.

member.description: The member id (mem_...) from gate_manage_members with operation="list"

tools.name: gate_validate_config
tools.description: Validate and normalize an odile.yaml or JSON config without reading or changing a project. Returns errors, warnings and normalized config. Use gate_check_setup for actual project settings; use gate_sync_declarative to apply the validated file.

config.description: The whole odile.yaml (or the same as JSON) as text

tools.name: gate_sync_declarative
tools.description: Apply an odile.yaml or JSON config to create missing resources and reconcile supported settings. dry_run previews steps; new keys are shown once. Never revokes or deletes; existing route or rate differences are drift, not applied. Use gate_validate_config to check a file or gate_check_setup to inspect project protection.

config.description: The whole odile.yaml (or the same as JSON) as text

project_id.description: Optional: an existing project to sync

admin_key.description: Its admin key (ga_...), required with project_id. Read it from the .env; never print it.

dry_run.description: List the steps without changing anything
